{{Quote|Although the Clone Wars were over, some people never seemed to get the message.|Unknown 501st stormtrooper|<ref name="SW:BFII" />}}
The '''Separatist holdouts''', known also as the '''remnants of the CIS''', consisted of various disparate fragments of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] that remained active after the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|execution]] of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist leadership]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], trying to preserve their [[New Order (Separatist)|New Order]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used the existence of such holdouts as one of several excuses to continue production of various [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

The holdouts consisted of various independent worlds and systems mostly in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Some notable locations were the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and [[Enarc/Legends|Enarc]].

==History==
===Beginnings===
[[File:Death_San_Hill_Pogglestheless.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The newly anointed Sith Lord, Darth Vader, slaughtered the entire Separatist Council on Mustafar, leaving the Confederacy of Independent Systems leaderless.]]
With the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|death of the Separatist leaders]] at the hands of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the deactivation of the majority of the Separatist droid armies, the dissolution of the Confederacy's major commercial organizations, and the surrender of almost all remaining Separatist planets and forts, the Confederacy of Independent Systems effectively ceased to exist. With both the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] and the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith Apprentice]] having betrayed the Confederacy, its leaders were reduced to various [[Warlord/Legends|Warlords]] across the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. However, various small remnants, like the [[Trade Federation resistance]], managed to survive, but the Separatists were but a shadow of their former selves.

===Acherin===
{{Main|Battle of Acherin (Imperial Period)}}
{{Quote|We didn't dare to hope that we'd beat them. We hoped we would be enough of a nuisance that they'd just go away.|[[Toma (resistance leader)|Toma]]|<ref name="TLOTJ:DW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning]]''</ref>}}
At the [[19 BBY/Legends|close]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Separatists on [[Acherin]] were in the process of negotiating a peace treaty with the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Garen Muln]]. After Muln survived an assassination attempt made by his own [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] when [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was initiated, the Achernar Separatists retreated to their fortified cities, hid the Jedi until he could be evacuated off-world, and declared war on the emerging Galactic Empire.<ref name="TLOTJ:DW" />

For nearly a year, the Separatist resistance managed to keep the Empire at bay, in a war that inflicted great casualties on both sides. In the end, the forces of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Riwwel]] proved too powerful, and, in retribution for casualties sustained during the campaign, he razed the remaining resistance stronghold&mdash;the capital city [[Eluthan]].<ref name="TLOTJ:DW" />

===The Reconquest of the Rim===
{{Main|Reconquest of the Rim}}
The majority of Separatist holdouts were dealt with by the Empire between [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] in the [[Reconquest of the Rim]], a massive military campaign aimed at restoring order and establishing Imperial control in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

===Sy Myrth===
{{Main|Sy Myrthian Insurrection}}
[[File:SyMyrthianInsurrection-EGTW.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The path Imperial forces led by Admiral Adar Tallon and General Jan Dodonna took while combating Toonbuck Toora's holdout]]
Early on after the official end of the Clone Wars, an army and navy of still-active battle droids came under the control of former senator [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]]. Toora used these forces to conduct a campaign of resistance against the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She fortified her homeworld of [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] and captured several nearby worlds. In response the Empire sent [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] to deal with the holdout. After a string of losses for Toora, she was finally cornered over the planet [[Trasemene]] and a bloody battle ensued in which Toora died aboard her flagship ''[[Defiance's Banner]]''. All the remaining Separatist forces loyal to Toora were destroyed in the battle along with their leader, ending Separatist resistance in that region of space.

A handful of Separatist survivors fled into the [[Kreetan Narrows]] after the defeat and continued a low-level resistance, leading to the Empire's eventual [[Annexation of the northern Hutt territories|annexation]] of the region and the northern territories of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

===The Muuns===
{{Main|Ciutric Offensive}}
[[File:Hurst_Romodi.jpg|thumb|right|250px|General Hurst Romodi would personally lead Imperial forces to victory against Separatist holdouts in the Ciutric Offensive.]]
After the end of the Clone Wars, Separatist forces led by the [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] fled from the worlds of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]. These Separatist forces linked up with the [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]] and other [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on the world of [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]]. The Empire in response sent [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]], and the two beat the Separatists off Vinsoth. After this loss the Muun leadership dug in on the planet [[Binquaros]] and sent their fleet to [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]]. Romodi began to grind down the holdouts on Binquaros while Screed shredded the Separatist fleet at Bimmiel. While all this was going on, a group of pirates and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] who had been pushed from the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] broke through Screed's rear guard and beat Romodi on Binquaros, freeing the Muun. This new force fled for the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] but it was intercepted in the [[Vardoss system/Legends|Vardoss system]] and crushed.

===Enarc===
{{Main|Trade Federation resistance|Five Veils Campaign}}
{{Quote|Where is Gunray? Where is Haako? A third-tier flunky has no right to negotiate on the Trade Federation's behalf. We have our battleships. We have our droids. If Palpatine wants our wealth, let him come and take it.|Marath Vooro|<ref name="RHNSIE16:5:241">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>}}
Although acting [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Sentepeth Findos]] had formally dissolved the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], others refused to admit defeat. On Enarc, [[Customs Vizier]] [[Marath Vooro]] explicitly denied the authority of Findos and challenged the new Empire with a show of force.<ref name="RHNSIE16:5:241" />
Despite his confidence, Vooro and other Trade Federation factions were [[Five Veils Campaign|defeated]] by the Empire, ending the Federation permanently.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

===Bothan sector===
{{Main|Noolian Crisis|Bothan Space/Legends}}
In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]] was reportedly invaded by [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] separatists that allied with [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] raiders. They managed to control the worlds of [[Nooli]] and [[Galboron]]. In response, the Empire sent [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Par Lankin]] who managed to liberate the entire sector that same standard year.

===The Western Reaches Operation===
{{Main|Western Reaches Operation}}
In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Separatist forces under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kendu Ultho]] linked up with [[Iska system/Legends|Iska]] pirates and managed to maintain control within the sectors until the Empire sent [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] to liberate those systems that same year. Separatist forces used organic-accompanied vulture-droid starfighters along with [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] against the Imperial Navy but all efforts were lost as all ninety-five systems and eight sectors were eventually liberated and brought an end to the separatist influence over that region.

===Shrouded Offensive===
====Phase One====
A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the Empire managed to discover a Separatist enclave, led by General [[Atticus Farstar]], on the planet [[Ostor]], located at the fringes of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], and was important enough for the Emperor's enforcer, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to be dispatched to the planet to bring it under Imperial rule. The invasion began with an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]], five [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RTs]], and 246 [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]]. The two armies squared-off at a cliffside. The Separatists held a banner which read in part "General Rohn is a". The Imperial general ordered his forces to advance and take the banner down. Taking casualties, the Separatists slowly fell back. [[Clone Commander|Clone commander]] noticed something strange about the retreat, and tried to get Rohn to call off the pursuit. He ran to the transport, and [[Rohn]] ordered him to stand down. He then boarded the transport, avoiding getting hit by two of the AT-RTs which had been ordered to take him into custody, one of which hit the transport, and Commander Malsuum killed him as the general tried to forbid anyone from retreating. Malsuum was unable to stop the advance, and all the stormtroopers were killed within fifteen minutes by an ambush by Farstar, who had planted two armies on either side of the canyon. [[Lima Starcourt]], [[Phootla Veer]], and [[Reebo Keen]] helped plan the defense of their planet.

====Phase Two====
After [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] to take a more hands-on approach, he returned with an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial'']][[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|-class Star Destroyer]]. He led [[Green Squadron (Galactic Empire)|Green Squadron]] in an offensive against the enemy's shielded city. They encountered minimal anti-aircraft fire. As they attacked the shield, they were ambushed by [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]]&mdash;piloted by followers of the rogue clone [[Kaddak (clone trooper)|Kaddak]]&mdash;and took multiple casualties. Malsuum then went to sabotage their operation in order to quickly end the fighting. He was able to disengage the shield, allowing the Imperial fighters to attack the city. Vader then led the ground forces into the city. Kaddak personally engaged Malsuum in personal combat. The army slaughtered all resistance in an hour as the city was left in ruins from the aerial strikes. Vader proceeded into the city and executed the three leaders, who never drew their weapons.

===New Plympto===
{{Main|Cleansing of New Plympto|New Plympto resistance (Imperial Period)}}
{{Quote|I would not throw my life away so hastily&mdash;or so vainly&mdash;but neither am I done fighting for the principles on which the Republic was based.|Dass Jennir|<ref name="SWR80:ITUP2">[[Republic 80|''Republic'' 80]]</ref>}}
On [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]], the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] Separatist army fought on against the Empire, even as their chances of winning slimmed each day. They were led by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Dass Jennir]], who had survived an assassination attempt on his life during the execution of Order 66 and had subsequently joined forces with the Nosaurians.<ref name="SWR80:ITUP2" /><ref name="SWDT1:TPTNP1">[[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]]</ref>

The fighting continued for a month, eventually leading to the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] being sent to assist the Imperial force in ending the uprising. At the [[Cleansing of New Plympto#A month of fighting|Battle of Half-Axe Pass]], the last fragment of the Nosaurian army was destroyed, with the surviving soldiers being slaughtered. Only Jennir and [[Bomo Greenbark]] survived the massacre.<ref name="SWDT1:TPTNP1" />

===Dellso's remnant===
====Beginnings====
{{Quote|By the time we made our way to the molten surface of Mustafar, it was apparent Dellso had been a busy little bug.|Anonymous 501st [[retired clone trooper]]|<ref name="SW:BFII" />}}
[[File:Gizor_Dellso_and_bodyguards.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Gizor Dellso, one of the leading members of the Confederate Remnants, and some fellow Geonosians on Mustafar]]
Another Separatist to resist after the Clone Wars was [[Gizor Dellso]]. Dellso remained in denial that the Clone Wars were over, and, being the creator of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] signal beacon, reactivated a secret [[Techno Union droid factory/Legends|droid factory]] hidden near the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]], building his own private droid army. Becoming the leader of at least one Confederate remnant, Dellso stayed on Mustafar, plotting to overthrow the Galactic Empire.<ref name="SW:BFII" />

====Escalation====
{{Quote|Although the Clone Wars were over, some people never seem to get the message. The worst case of denial was Gizor Delso, a Geonosian Separatist who'd somehow escaped Lord Vader's efforts to wipe out the remnants of the CIS. Lord Vader tracked him to Mustafar, and brought us in to finish the job.|Retired clone trooper|audio=GizorDellso1.flac|<ref name="SW:BFII" />}}
In the meantime, the Empire tracked down remaining Separatist strongholds and hideouts, either forcing their surrender or destroying them outright&mdash;sometimes even using their own hardware against them, such as reprogrammed [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="ROTS:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

By [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]], Dellso had amassed a [[Gizor Dellso's navy|fleet of starships]] in readiness for his new campaign against the Empire and had the droids to man them, as well as re-activated droid starfighters. Dellso also discovered [[Confederate infantry prototype|old battle droid data]] stored in the data computers of the surface complex and made provisions to manufacture the experimental droids. This next generation battle droid was to have become a major addition to the Confederacy, but the government was dissolved before production began. Adding to his peril, Dellso was also in possession of sensitive Imperial data, pertaining to a new starfighter the Empire was intending to have built.<ref name="SW:BFII" />

====Suppression====
{{Quote|Truth be told, we'd all had our fill of those gear-heads during the war, and we couldn't stomach the thought of going through another one. So we blew them up, blew up the droids, blew up the factory, damn near blew up the planet.|Retired clone trooper|<ref name="SW:BFII" />}}
{{Main|Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)}}
[[File:BF_Mustafar_4.jpg|thumb|left|225px|A stormtrooper of the 501st Legion during the assault on the Klegger Corp Mining Facility.]]
Eventually revealing themselves to the Galactic Empire, Darth Vader tracked Dellso's fleet back to Mustafar, where he dispatched the 501st Legion to put down the last remnants of the CIS, once and for all. The Empire established orbital positions, and continued to [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|lay siege to Mustafar]]. The engineers of the 501st destroyed the experimental droid schematics and planted an orbital beacon in the droid factory while engaging the enemies they had thought they would never see again. Meanwhile, Dellso and his officers desperately launched attacks on the Imperial forces. However, they were all eventually killed, and the factory was destroyed by an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].<ref name="SW:BFII" />

===The Alliance and Separatism===
Following the signing of the [[Corellian Treaty]] and the [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], most Separatist holdouts that had survived 17 years after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]' [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]], such as the [[Bryx Freedom Fighters]] and Separatist prisoners of [[Kota's Militia]], were absorbed into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], although certain former Separatists such as the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Blox Hatha]] were refused membership into the Rebel Alliance owing to previous war crimes. Even with this setback, Blox flew a privateer vessel in support bearing a Rebel [[Letter of marque/Legends|letter of marque and reprisal]]. The Rebels managed to get their hands on Separatist war material, such as [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleships]], [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]], [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyers]] and [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]. Many surviving frigates had roamed the galaxy for years, with their old crews serving as mercenaries or [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. They modified their vessels to such an extent that many were unrecognizable from their original configuration. As such, they went well with the rag-tag look of the early [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref>

During the Imperial Period, a group known as the [[Bryx Freedom Fighters]] in the [[Bryx sector/Legends|Bryx sector]] led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horn Ambigene/Legends|Horn Ambigene]] remained partial towards the Separatist cause even after the Confederacy's fragmentation. They played multiple roles in resisting imperial forces over their sector until they were later reorganized with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="Warfare" />

Despite the gradual dissolution and/or incorporation into the Rebel Alliance of surviving Separatist holdout forces, Imperial officers like [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] still referred to Separatism as a current threat, alongside rebels and criminal enterprises, as late as [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="SWBAC-C">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref>

===After Yavin===
====Nuisance on Kashyyyk====
On [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], a few battle droids and droidekas left over from the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] ignored the shutdown signal and were left active for decades in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a few spacers were tasked with destroying these battle droids as they had become a threat to the wildlife and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] hunters that used this desolate territory.<ref name="galaxies">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

====Leftovers on Geonosis====
{{Main|Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)}}
On [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], a [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|number of droids]] left behind from the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Original Battle of Geonosis]] did not respond to the shut-down order but continued functioning for several decades. These droids managed to survive in functional condition inside [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|undiscovered pockets]] of Geonosis's canyons, all the way into the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], along with other relics from the Clone Wars, such as a [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class core ship]].<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the droids opened fire on Imperial detachments that crashed into the trenches in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] during a [[Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|space battle]] above the planet. Most of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were overwhelmed and killed. A Rebel pilot, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], was forced to crash-land on the planet after losing his starfighter's [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizers]]. Antilles managed to wipe out the remaining stormtroopers and nearby battle droids before escaping the world in a modified [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7]] that he found, making good use of its [[Seismic charge/Legends|seismic charges]] against Imperial forces.<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS" />

====Relics on Hypori====
{{Main|Ground Battle on Hypori}}
On [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], multiple templates of [[Droideka Mark II]]s were left behind in a hidden droid foundry on Hypori to serve as automated defenses. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Tyber Zann]] and [[Urai Fen]] found word of the abandoned factory and decided to infiltrate the facility. They were ambushed by droidekas and had to battle their way deeper into the facility for Urai Fen to turn the factory security off. [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] attempted to capture Tyber but was later persuaded to join his cause for the consortium. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] and his forces arrived to capture the foundry which sent the trio to reprogram the factory security to fight for the consortium. Outnumbered and outmatched, Jabba conceded and gave Tyber the facility along with the rest of the planet.

===After Endor===
====Outbound Flight Recovery====
{{Main|Expedition to Outbound Flight}}
The [[Outbound Flight]] was an expedition voyage that launched in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] and attempted to make several colonizations in the Outer Rim. The project was sabotaged by Chancellor Palpatine when he sent a Trade Federation taskforce of vulture droids, battle droids, and droidekas. Outbound Flight was severely damaged by a Chiss fleet under the command of Commander Thrawn, all of the colonists and Jedi in the Dreadnaughts died in radiation explosions. However many colonists and the Jedi [[Lorana Jinzler]] survived in the central storage area. [[Lorana Jinzler]] and [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Thrass]] (the brother of Thrawn) crash landed and unfortunately died in the attempt. The vessel had crashed on [[The Redoubt/Legends|The Redoubt]] and the colonies were nevertheless created. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] discovered the wreckage in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]]. They were met under fire by an aged droideka that failed to respond to the shutdown in 19 BBY. Both Jedi had trouble with the droideka but eventually destroyed it along with any last remaining relics of the Federation and Separatist influence.

==Military and war material==
{{Main|Gizor Dellso's army|Gizor Dellso's navy}}
The military of the various Separatist remnants usually&mdash;but not always&mdash;consisted of droid and ship models that had been used in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] and the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. The ground units included [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], and [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|Heavy Missile Platforms]]. [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] warriors were also a part of at least one faction. [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] soldiers were mentioned fighting and leading battles against the Empire during several reconquests and sieges. The navies consisted of primarily ''Providence''-class carrier/destroyers, [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleships]], and ''Munificent''-class star frigates for support. The holdout navies retained most of the CIS's major [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], such as [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture'' droids]] and [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighter]].
